notes: Added missing foundational and validation stories to complete FEAT-1 coverage across schema, core logic hardening, and unit testing.

FEAT-1-STORY-31.title: Provider Search Request/Response Schema Validation
FEAT-1-STORY-31.description: Define and enforce strict Pydantic schemas for provider search inputs and outputs, including location filters, specialty queries, and result structure consistency for downstream chat rendering.

FEAT-1-STORY-32.title: Vector Search and Taxonomy Fallback Orchestration Hardening
FEAT-1-STORY-32.description: Enhance provider_search_service orchestration to ensure deterministic fallback behavior when vector search yields low-confidence or empty results, including threshold handling and result merging.

FEAT-1-STORY-33.title: Location Filtering Accuracy and FIPS Mapping Validation
FEAT-1-STORY-33.description: Validate and refine location filtering logic including ZIP, city, state, and county resolution using FIPS mapping to ensure geographically accurate provider results.

FEAT-1-STORY-34.title: Unit Tests for Provider Search Service
FEAT-1-STORY-34.description: Implement unit tests covering vector search execution, taxonomy fallback paths, location filtering, and edge cases such as empty results and malformed queries.
